### From `packages/core/src/registries.ts`

#### <a id="core-contributiondecl"></a>`ContributionDecl`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/registries.ts`

One entry a system adds to a registry (`Manifest.contributes`). Its component and match logic are in the system's
client bundle, under the same registry and name; this declaration tells the hub and the web app which bundles to load.

```ts
type ContributionDecl = {
  registry: `${string}/${string}`;
  name: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string | undefined;
  icon?: string | undefined;
  shape?: {
    channels: {
      name: string;
      label: string;
      accepts: ("number" | "boolean" | "date" | "text" | "integer" | "datetime" | "time" | "uuid" | "json" | "binary")[];
      required: boolean;
      many: boolean;
      min?: number | undefined;
      role?: "group" | "measure" | undefined;
    }[];
    rows: {
      min: number;
      max?: number | undefined;
    };
    whole: boolean;
    rules: ({
      rule: "distinct";
      channel: string;
      max: number;
    } | {
      rule: "non-negative";
      channel: string;
    } | {
      rule: "bounded";
      channel: string;
    } | {
      rule: "distinct-columns";
      channels: string[];
    } | {
      rule: "links";
      from: string;
      to: string;
    })[];
    styles: {
      name: string;
      label: string;
      whole?: true | undefined;
      needs?: string[] | undefined;
    }[];
    claims: {
      claim: "range";
      channel: string;
    }[];
    priority: {
      band: "floor" | "structural" | "encoded" | "time-encoded";
      terms: ("temporal-key" | "low-cardinality" | "enum-key" | "high-null" | "many-categories")[];
    };
    size?: "window" | "top-n" | "partition" | "aggregate" | undefined;
    pageSize?: number | undefined;
  } | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-resulttable"></a>`ResultTable`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/registries.ts`

Rows as the person sees them: columns once, then each row as an array in column order. `total` is there when the
source counted it; `truncated` says more rows exist past `offset + rows.length`.

```ts
type ResultTable = {
  columns: {
    name: string;
    kind: "number" | "boolean" | "date" | "text" | "integer" | "datetime" | "time" | "uuid" | "json" | "binary";
    nullable: boolean;
    label?: string | undefined;
    type?: TypeDef<any> | undefined;
    ref?: `${string}/${string}` | undefined;
    role?: "group" | "measure" | "attribute" | undefined;
    key?: boolean | undefined;
    editable?: boolean | undefined;
  }[];
  rows: z.core.util.JSONType[][];
  offset: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  sort: {
    column: string;
    dir: "asc" | "desc";
  }[];
  limit?: number | undefined;
  total?: number | undefined;
  write?: {
    affected: number;
  } | undefined;
  records?: {
    type: `${string}/${string}`;
    id: string;
  } | undefined;
  drill?: {
    fn: `${string}/${string}`;
    args: Record<string, z.core.util.JSONType>;
    keys: string[];
  } | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-visualchannel"></a>`VisualChannel`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/registries.ts`

One input of a visual: a named slot columns bind to (`category`, `value`, `x`, `start`), named after the ECharts
encode dimension where there is one; the column kinds it takes; whether it must be bound; whether it takes several
columns (a line chart's series; at least `min` of them); and the role it wants (a category a `group` key, a value a
`measure`). A column shown only in a tooltip is not bound and does not count towards coverage.

```ts
type VisualChannel = {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  accepts: ("number" | "boolean" | "date" | "text" | "integer" | "datetime" | "time" | "uuid" | "json" | "binary")[];
  required: boolean;
  many: boolean;
  min?: number | undefined;
  role?: "group" | "measure" | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-visualshape"></a>`VisualShape`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/registries.ts`

The data a visual draws, declared (widget pass: product's extended, declarative shape), so the hub and agents judge a
fit and rank visuals without client code (`rankVisuals` in `visuals.ts`): its channels, how many rows it draws,
whether it only tells the truth about a whole result, the rules its data must meet, how it stays honest when the
result is big, its styles, the args it can drive, its priority band and terms, and its page size if it pages. A
client may still veto a fit; it never scores one.

```ts
type VisualShape = {
  channels: {
    name: string;
    label: string;
    accepts: ("number" | "boolean" | "date" | "text" | "integer" | "datetime" | "time" | "uuid" | "json" | "binary")[];
    required: boolean;
    many: boolean;
    min?: number | undefined;
    role?: "group" | "measure" | undefined;
  }[];
  rows: {
    min: number;
    max?: number | undefined;
  };
  whole: boolean;
  rules: ({
    rule: "distinct";
    channel: string;
    max: number;
  } | {
    rule: "non-negative";
    channel: string;
  } | {
    rule: "bounded";
    channel: string;
  } | {
    rule: "distinct-columns";
    channels: string[];
  } | {
    rule: "links";
    from: string;
    to: string;
  })[];
  styles: {
    name: string;
    label: string;
    whole?: true | undefined;
    needs?: string[] | undefined;
  }[];
  claims: {
    claim: "range";
    channel: string;
  }[];
  priority: {
    band: "floor" | "structural" | "encoded" | "time-encoded";
    terms: ("temporal-key" | "low-cardinality" | "enum-key" | "high-null" | "many-categories")[];
  };
  size?: "window" | "top-n" | "partition" | "aggregate" | undefined;
  pageSize?: number | undefined;
};
```
